pathAssistantSteps.info:
• Provide governance sign-off prior to submitting a proposal and or pricing (RFP / RFI indicative and firm and binding)​
  • Secure approval to submit from the EDRA Board given the presented business case and risk profile​
  • This is typically seeking approval that is NOT ROM – pricing as part of an RFI / RFP requirement ​
  • Note: EDRA3 approval is required each time there is a material change to the offer or the associated risk profile

• Contract change is defined as a change to the scope of the contract: Legal T&Cs, Pricing, Products, Services, SLAs and contracting entities (which are not in, or are different from, the current contracted scope)​
  • Change which was pre-approved and is specified in the contract (framework)​
  • EDRA 5 does not include any new services or products; these must be taken via the EDRA process for approval as new opportunities​

Revise techniques to increase future wins.
  • What contributed to losing this opportunity?
  • What do we need to do differently to improve our chances of winning?
  • Schedule a follow-up task or event for this account.

• Provide an effective qualification mechanism for all opportunities where bid support is required​
  • Ensure that opportunity is clear and comprehensive enough to assess​
  • Ensure that an opportunity is profitable, winnable, and deliverable for Echo - in the sweet spot !

• Provide governance approval of the final negotiated position prior to contract signature & final draft contract​
  • Validate the business case / P&L (cash flow and revenues) ​
  • Confirm the delivery plan and commit necessary resources in accordance with the plan​
  • Understand all risks and their mitigation
